title: prisma migrate dev
description: Use prisma migrate dev to create and apply migrations during local development.

data.text: `prisma migrate dev` is the primary migration command for development. It compares your `schema.prisma` to the database, generates a migration, applies it, and regenerates Prisma Client.

items: Edit `schema.prisma` to add or change a model
Prisma generates the SQL migration in `prisma/migrations/`
The migration is applied to the database

data.title: Create a Migration
data.content: Create a migration to add a Post model.

items: Prisma compares the current database schema to your `schema.prisma`
It generates an SQL migration file in `prisma/migrations/`
The migration is applied to the database
Prisma Client is regenerated with updated types

data.title: Tip
data.text: Give migrations descriptive names like `add_posts_table` or `rename_user_email_to_contact_email`. This makes reviewing migration history much easier.
